The source identifies the experiment in Chapter 5 of the associated sand-slope thesis. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 2018. Format: mp4; jpg; txt. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
